# S5.7 — Land the C2 web surface and MCP write/analysis groups (§7.2/§7.3; R-2.11.2, R-2.11.3)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.6` (PR #88) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C2 depth of both first-party
surfaces. **`hh-web`** gains the editing
surface end to end: the V4 editor, V5
launcher, V3 operations/timetravel, V6
frontier/surface/strata/reliability/transfer,
V11 experiment/bundle and V12 console views,
plus the C2 write ops — every call admitted
through the closed catalogue, every write
riding the writer-session mint
(`idempotency_key`, `invocation`, responder
identity, surface `registrar`), with browser-
supplied authority fields stripped. **`hh-mcp-
lab`** gains the C2 tool groups: analysis and
write tools, `serve_bundle`, resources +
subscriptions, the tasks carrier, the
`human_principal` approval channel, and
`service`/`provider_client` caller bindings
with the `subject_kind = client` rule.

No second operation schema, no far-side state:
`ExposureDefinition` data lowers into the one
served catalogue and every call passes caller
binding → permissions → supply-surface Π →
effect lifecycle → budgets → dispatch → typed
result/refusal — identical over stdio and
Streamable HTTP.

## What landed

- **`hh-web` C2 views + ops** — V3/V4/V5/V6/
  V11/V12 view families rendered as pure
  projections of canonical responses; C2
  writes/Lab reads in the closed admission
  catalogue; session minting of idempotency,
  invocation, responder and `registrar` fields
  (browser-supplied `idempotency_key`/
  `invocation`/`attestation` stripped).
- **`HirDiff` editing + attestation**
  (AC-R-2.11.2-9) — `lab.assembly.apply` lands
  the minted `registrar`; `attestation` exists
  only as the human's act — a widening
  `authority_delta` without it fails at the
  registry's own gate.
- **Fork presentation** (AC-R-2.11.2-11) —
  incoherent fork positions resolve to the
  nearest coherent fork points; merged state
  is never fabricated.
- **`hh-mcp-lab` C2 groups** —
  `ToolGroup::{Analysis, Write, Hosting}` with
  `analyze`/`render`/`diff_reports`/`power`,
  `apply`/`publish`/`register`, and
  `serve_bundle` (lowered through `lab.serve`,
  minting `session_handle`); `entities.
  permissions` parsed and coverage-validated
  at exposure link.
- **Bindings** — `CallerKind::{Service,
  ProviderClient}`; OAuth `subject_kind =
  client` binds only those two kinds; identity
  never inferred from payloads.
- **Delegate write gate** — uncovered
  delegates refuse `DelegateWriteForbidden` on
  write-class tools; covered delegates reach
  the kernel's own authority.
- **Tasks carrier** — capability negotiation
  (`-32021` when unnegotiated), task ids over
  durable surface-run handles, exhaustive
  status fold, `tasks/get|update|cancel`, and
  `inputResponses[]` → `respond_permission`
  under the `human_principal` gate.
- **Resources + subscriptions** —
  templates/list/read/subscribe/unsubscribe,
  binding-scoped ledger-backed reads,
  `notifications/resources/updated` minted
  only after the durable row, subscriptions
  dying with their binding.
- **Approval channel** — `respond_approval`
  is `human_principal`-only (typed
  `IllegitimateEndorsement` for every other
  kind, durable refused row).
- **Assumption debt** — `tasks_carrier` and
  `resource_carrier` records required at link
  (`MissingDebt` on removal), alongside the
  C1 carriers.
